notes: 插件更新卡片新增「npm 下载路径」一行，列出实际兜底地址（npmmirror 国内快 + npmjs 官方权威双源）；GitHub release 整段不通时，更新包自动依次兜底从这两个 npm 源下载，避开单一镜像发版后的同步窗口期。仍按 version.json 里的权威 sha256 校验，换源不放宽校验。实测 npm tarball 与 GitHub release tgz 是同一份产物、sha256 一致。
notesEn: The plugin update card now shows an "npm download URL" line listing the actual fallback addresses (npmmirror for mainland speed + official npmjs as authoritative, two sources). When the GitHub release download is unreachable, the update package automatically falls back through both npm sources in order, avoiding a single mirror's post-release sync window. Still verified against the authoritative sha256 in version.json — switching source never relaxes verification. The npm tarball is byte-identical to the GitHub release tgz (same sha256).
